questions.lead: The Tooro Kingdom crowned a new king on 29 September 2026. The Babiito royal clan had selected him on 9 September.
questions.prompt: Which country is the Tooro Kingdom in?

questions.lead: The man crowned as the new king of Tooro had a working life before the throne. For years he appeared on Ugandan television.
questions.prompt: Which kind of programme did he present?

questions.lead: A bill setting national rules for paying college athletes passed the United States Senate on 28 September 2026. There were 22 votes against it.
questions.prompt: How many senators voted for the bill?

questions.lead: The Protect College Sports Act would make college athletes report what they earn from their name, image and likeness. The duty to report starts above a set amount.
questions.prompt: Above what amount would those earnings have to be reported?

questions.lead: Scientists tested the hearing of wild blacktip sharks by playing low-frequency sounds through an underwater speaker. A drone filmed the sharks from above as they reacted.
questions.prompt: From how far away did the sharks detect the sounds?

explanations: The Tooro Kingdom is in Uganda. The Babiito royal clan selected him on 9 September 2026 and his coronation took place on 29 September.
He presented the news. He was a television news anchor and editor at the Uganda Broadcasting Corporation.
The Senate passed the bill 77-22. The vote was taken on 28 September 2026 and the bill then went to the United States House of Representatives.
Earnings greater than $600 would have to be reported. The bill covers the usage of players' name, image and likeness, and also transfers.
The sharks detected the sounds from up to 74 metres away. That is 243 feet, substantially farther than had previously been demonstrated in freely swimming sharks.

sources.excerpt: On 9 September 2026, he was selected by the Babiito royal clan to succeed Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV as Omukama of Tooro, a selection endorsed by the Tooro Kingdom Supreme Council on 15 September. His coronation took place on 29 September 2026.
He worked for the Uganda Broadcasting Corporation (UBC) as a television news anchor and editor.
He became known on Ugandan television through his presentation of English-language news bulletins, including UBC News Tonight.
The main goal of S. 4668 is to regulate college sports, especially the usage of players' name, image, and likeness (NIL) and transfers.
The bill will require reporting of all NIL earnings greater than $600.
On September 28, 2026 at 9:42 PM the Senate passed S. 4668 77-22 sending the bill to the United States House of Representatives.
Researchers studying blacktip sharks (Carcharhinus limbatus) used an underwater speaker, a drone, and wild sharks swimming naturally in coastal waters.
They detected low frequency sounds from distances of up to 74 meters (243 feet), substantially farther than had previously been demonstrated in freely swimming sharks.
